review_notes.round_1: REJECT. Seven assertions in internal/pipeline broke because the enumeration moved out of index.md while they still read it. The builder had run only the isolated module the acceptance stages, which does not see that package -- green in a narrow scope is not green.
review_notes.measured_design_choice: reference.md is written only for two or more pages, and the reason is measured rather than aesthetic: cmd/regenerate-docs walks OutputDir excluding only index.md by name, so a reference page written for a single-page run is counted as a second generated page in the CLI's own docs=N summary. The unit selector now pins BOTH declared behaviours -- one page links straight through with no reference page, two or more move the enumeration -- which is stronger than the single case it asserted before.
review_notes.sibling_counters: AUR-483's acceptance, integration program and e2e each count generated pages to prove the scope filter worked, and each saw reference.md as a fourth page. All three now skip it exactly as they already skip index.md: both are scaffold, not content extracted from source.
